title: Files as data and as context
sub: The single film of Documents as data, the last series of Modern data basics: a document is data to read and context to cite. Supplier invoices, written for people, are read into a table with the platform's functions, each row keeping its file, and checked like any other data; signed contracts are kept as they were signed, with their metadata beside them, so a person or an agent finds the right version and cites it; and what the university's own applications write, they write as data, in standard structures, so nobody has to read it back.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: the university's night map, its parts as dark glass. Light blue is data moving and the platform's structure, gold what people agree on (a contract, a form, a definition), green a check that passes, red one that fails, amber a person's turn, and lilac personal data, always with a lock. The opening, in Washington in 1842 and Brussels in 1853, is lamp-lit, with the oceans drawn as a chart of the time.
